title: 100 Cheap Agents vs 1 Frontier Model
description:
One frontier model isn't the answer.

A hundred cheap ones might be.

You've been buying intelligence.

You should be buying attempts.

Most work needs volume, not genius.

So I ran four tests.

The cheap swarm held up.

Costs dropped hard.

Quality didn't.

It's like drilling one well or twenty.

Twenty cheap holes find water first.

You're not falling behind on models.

You're behind on strategy.

Watch the tests and copy the setup.

#fable5 #aiagents #aimodels #aistrategy #aitools
